text: Skip to main content DMC Marrakech for the best incentives and events DMC Marrakech for the best incentives and events DISCOVER Marrakech DMC Marrakech DMC Marrakech DMC Marrakech DMC Marrakech - Marrakech, the city of roses, is a destination that should definitely be on your bucket list. Picture palace restaurants with bubbling water fountains, mosaic walls and rose petals scattered on table cloths where the warm air is filled with the scent of cinnamon and incense. The people still travel by donkey through the city, snake charmers perform their dance on the market and the bustling souks invite passing strangers to buy silver jewelry and hand-woven carpets. Marrakech is blessed with the most stunning hotels, historic riads and amazing restaurants where you can feast on traditional tagines and couscous. Marrakech is very easy to combine with a desert tour, where you take a camel ride and spend your night in a luxury tent under a star lit sky.
